svg.aria-label: DEVELOPER TOOLS · CLI: A Terminal Typing Trainer That Ships on Homebrew. Monkeytype, but it lives in your terminal — 15+ themes, a 25-lesson touch-typing curriculum, and an error heatmap, rendered with React's Ink and shipped via Homebrew and npm.
